ui_bugs.issue: Public /cabang page renders BLANK WHITE. Uncaught pageerror: 'Map container is already initialized.' This is the classic react-leaflet + React 18 StrictMode double-mount problem. The whole page (including cabang cards below the map) fails to render because the parent throws inside render. Users cannot see the branches directory or map at all.

action_items: FIX Cabang public page crash: wrap MapContainer to prevent StrictMode double-init. Options: (a) remove <React.StrictMode> in src/index.js, (b) memoize MapContainer with React.memo + stable key and mount via useEffect once, (c) upgrade react-leaflet to version compatible with React 18 strict mode, or (d) render map lazily with a mount guard (e.g., useRef flag + useEffect cleanup that calls container.remove()).

rca of the issue: Root cause of Cabang page crash: react-leaflet's MapContainer initializes a Leaflet map on the underlying DOM node in componentDidMount / useEffect. React 18 StrictMode intentionally mounts→unmounts→remounts components in development to catch side effects. On the second mount, Leaflet finds the map already initialized on the same DOM node and throws 'Map container is already initialized.' Because the throw happens inside render of the parent div (via React Fiber), the entire Cabang route errors out and only the blank error-boundary fallback (or nothing) is shown. Reproduce: navigate to https://dzikir-sholawat-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/cabang - white screen. Mitigation: (1) remove StrictMode wrapper, (2) mount MapContainer inside a component that uses a mount-guard ref and cleanup handler calling map.remove() on unmount, or (3) use whenCreated / MapContainer's internal ref pattern from react-leaflet v4 with a key that stays stable.
